decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 (2026-06-30), but no invite and no key milestone in 6 days, and no replies to two outreach emails (email:b18f45a3, email:43942fd1). Silence plus solo Starter usage suggests low but nonzero chance of self-serve activation in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A quick hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the work your team is actually tracking is usually the step that makes things click.

When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's next for Timber Collective.

Best,
Priya
